answer: A bond of 44% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in velvet, and inlet reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 128 aliases, and each one needs its own funded vertex account. Repeating the trick 9 times costs 55 separate deposits and 47 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
